# Fallback: robust duration extraction and best-effort playlist selection
import re

# ... assume we have simple_token and spotify_token
notes = find_all_from_pages(apis.simple_note.search_notes,
                            access_token=simple_token,
                            query="plan")
if not notes:
    apis.supervisor.complete_task(status="failure")
    return

content = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=notes[0].note_id,
                                     access_token=simple_token).content
# Try to extract any integer with "mins" if today's block is missing
matches = re.findall(r"(\d+)\s*mins?", content)
duration_mins = int(matches[0]) if matches else None
if duration_mins is None:
    apis.supervisor.complete_task(status="failure")
    return

playlists = find_all_from_pages(apis.spotify.show_playlist_library,
                                access_token=spotify_token)
# Pick the longest playlist
best = max(
    playlists,
    key=lambda pl: sum(apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid).duration for sid in pl.song_ids)
)
best_len_min = sum(apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid).duration for sid in best.song_ids) / 60
if best_len_min >= duration_mins:
    apis.spotify.play_music(access_token=spotify_token, playlist_id=best.playlist_id)
else:
    # No playlist is long enough; play the longest as a best-effort fallback
    apis.spotify.play_music(access_token=spotify_token, playlist_id=best.playlist_id)
